description: Provisional 1.33 legal-frame reaction matrix covering amplifying, transformative, Frozen/Shatter, Swirl, Crystallize, Catalyze, Burning, Dendro-core reactions, player reaction self-damage, and the disabled target-clock compatibility path.

notes: This is a deterministic regression fixture for the checked-in implementation, not official game data or a claim of complete gcsim parity.

The reaction-matrix vectors explicitly keep targetClockModel disabled and retain the 1.32 random seeds so their damage, state, positions, and event semantics remain the 1.32 compatibility baseline while the 1.33 config and run identities are frozen.
Target-local enemy Hitlag behavior is covered by separate 1.33 unit and integration fixtures, not by these disabled-clock vectors.
Player Burning, Bloom, Burgeon, and Hyperbloom self-damage is modeled against an explicit 10% resistance vector with auditable spatial checks, HP transitions, damage groups, and reverse references.
Burning preserves the frozen 1.30 compatibility phase difference (F+121 and hit-before-tick ordering).
Player movement, healing, death/revival, non-Crystallize shields, ordinary enemy attacks, gadget Hitlag, and defense halt are not modeled.
Complete Aura source overlap, character ICD databases, particles, action frames, reaction hooks, and character/weapon databases remain outside this fixture.
